policy.scope: Consumed development only. Current PNG splice and JPEG inpainting components reproduced. Four native-coordinate RGB crops use the unchanged FUSED checkpoint and semantic backbone. No service, authorship probability, whole-file confidence or fresh-validation claim.

native.selection: Smallest gate >=0.5 meeting the original-only displayed-region budget

jpeg75.selection: Smallest gate >=0.5 meeting the original-only displayed-region budget

review.limits: Consumed development only; no independent accuracy or adoption evidence. Cropping changes model context; these are uncalibrated review cues. Source-paired RGB-difference references measure changed pixels, not independently verified semantic editing boundaries. Formats share source groups; a separate source-disjoint frozen confirmation is required.

data_terms: TGIF/TGIF2 source references and annotations: CC-BY-SA-4.0; https://github.com/IDLabMedia/tgif-dataset. No source images, masks, private files, model weights or raw model-map arrays included. Code retains its existing license.
